findings.expected: Visible focus should be evidenced for all essential interactive controls.
findings.observed: The artifact defines a visible focus-visible outline, and the supplemental focus render shows focus on the brand link. CTA focus and complete keyboard traversal are not evidenced.

findings.expected: Footer copy remains comfortably legible and balanced at the narrow breakpoint.
findings.observed: The footer is present, but supplemental scroll-end evidence shows both footer labels wrapping into very small 8px text. The required top-of-page mobile render cannot show the footer because document height is 1025px.

findings.expected: Supporting typography should retain a distinctive, deliberate brand voice.
findings.observed: Georgia gives the display type a clear voice, while Arial/Helvetica utility text is highly legible but generic.

evidence_missing: No native scroll-end mobile capture in the required two-render pair; footer verification relies on supplemental mobile-footer.png.
